lines.text: The root is Cept! Receive, perceive, deceive.
Did you know? Cept is Latin for take.
Quick quiz! Which means down plus take?

words.ex: How do young people perceive social media?
The advertisement was designed to deceive customers about the real price.

publish.title: Cept root: receive, perceive and deceive
publish.value: Cept comes from Latin "capere" (to take, to seize). Words: receive, perceive and deceive. receive = re + ceive; perceive = per + ceive; deceive = de + ceive.
